column1: # Old Solr bugs that make an ad hoc check itself fail (owner 2026-10-26: only a bug whose witness fires the point's own
# declared throw counts; /users/ZhenyuLi/oldbug on node1, "fires this point's own throw"). Each runs the ad hoc check of
# its point on a tree of its own, graphchecker/solr-checks with that bug put back by hand and a workload for it
# (experiments/solr/trees.tsv, solr-bug-<jira>). The case directory solr-buggy-<jira> declares the check; its README
# the bug, the point, what was put back and why, and the result. A case's row is added with its directory.
# SOLR-6763 (solr-adhoc-38) has a README only: masked on today's code by SOLR-7844 (solr-buggy-6763/README.md).
